data.name: Artemios
data.gender_notes: Artemios is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek god Artemis, Artemios is a Christian name meaning 'God of the Hunt'. In Greek mythology, Artemis was the goddess of the wilderness, the hunt, and childbirth. As a Christian name, Artemios carries the spiritual significance of being a protector and provider, and the emotional traits of compassion and loyalty.
data.etymology: Artemios belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of the Hunt.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Artemios total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_greek.name: Αρτέμιος
in_greek.meaning: Αρτέμιος ονομάζεται από το θεό της άρτου, Αρτέμιος είναι άντρας της άρτου
in_greek.long_meaning: Αρτέμιος ονομάζεται από τη θεά της άρτου, η οποία ήταν θεά της γονιμότητας και της φύσης, το όνομα Αρτέμιος είναι σύνθετο από το άρτος και ονομασία, σημαίνει ότι ο Αρτέμιος είναι άντρας που έχει σχέση με την άρτους, η οποία ήταν θημωνίτης και θυσιαστήριο, το όνομα Αρτέμιος είναι επίσης συνδεδεμένο με την αρχαία ελληνική πόλη της Αρτέμιος

in_latin.name: Artemios
in_latin.meaning: Artemios nomen significat quem deum panis, Artemios est vir panis
in_latin.long_meaning: Artemios nomen significat quem deum panis, qui erat deus fertility et naturae, nomen Artemios est compositum ex panis et nomen, significat quod Artemios est vir qui habet relationem cum panibus, qui erant thymitae et sacrificium, nomen Artemios est etiam coniunctum cum urbe antiqua Artemius

in_english.name: Artemios
in_english.meaning: Artemios is a name derived from the Greek god of bread, meaning a man of bread
in_english.long_meaning: Artemios is a name derived from the Greek god of bread, which was a god of fertility and nature, the name Artemios is a compound of panis and nomen, meaning that Artemios is a man who has a relationship with bread, which was thymites and a sacrifice, the name Artemios is also connected to the ancient Greek city of Artemius, in Christian tradition, the name Artemios is associated with a saint, Saint Artemios, a Greek martyr who lived in the 4th century, known for his piety and bravery, the name Artemios is also used in modern times as a given name, symbolizing a person who is connected to the spiritual aspect of bread, which represents nourishment and life
